episode: Consecutive same non-dominant truth from one output ID, until different positive truth or a gap exceeding the fixed number of unobserved output scans.
scope: Fixed already-exposed work16, no sealed data. Candidate admission and episode persistence are different axes. A persistent sequence is not itself a causal effect.
followup: If the continued share is large and long episodes start on sufficiently pure live tracks in enough scenes, isolate the first wrong update in a short truth-assisted diagnostic. No automatic release or production changes.
